discoveredIssues.description: Today has two date controls that can disagree: the list's Business date control and the day feed resolve 2026-10-16 (location tz + day_start_min=240, correct), but the module header Date control (#reservations-date-input, apps/app/app/routes/reservations+/_layout.tsx:98) shows the App-shell UTC calendar date 2026-10-17. The client-computed 'Jump to Today' target has the same problem because apps/app/app/utils/reservations/book-api.ts:1526 reads dayStartMin from the payload root while the response carries it at settings.dayStartMin=240. No contract assertion in round-3 scope covers it.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Thread the resolved business date (or settings.dayStartMin) from the loader into the shell date control and the client day-start computation so both show the service day the day feed uses.

discoveredIssues.description: Arabic reservations pages still render Latin breadcrumb segments ('Reservations / Today / Book'), unchanged from round 2. Outside VAL-BOOK-037's enumerated clauses (tabs, filters, badges, actions) but visible in the Arabic screenshots.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Wrap the breadcrumb segments in Lingui messages and translate them in ar.po, or hide them in the reservations shell.

suggestedChanges: When a milestone's fix commit changes business-date or time-zone behavior, note in the round plan that the business date is a service day (location tz + day_start_min), not the UTC/calendar date, so validators compute the expected value instead of assuming a UTC-midnight flip.
